title: [new feature] Highlighting
body:
Would be nice to retrieve also the keyword highlighting in the field _additional.
As https://solr.apache.org/guide/solr/latest/query-guide/highlighting.html.

This is a very important feature for any WooCommerce application.
It can be used for all operators, including "Ask".

comments.author: participant14
comments.body: /claim #2567 # Implementation Plan: Highlighting Feature for Issue #2567 ## Objective Add a highlighting feature (similar to Solr) that returns matching text snippets in search results. This should support **BM25**, **hybrid search**, and other keyword-based queries. --- ## 1. Core Data Structures ### `entities/additional/highlight.go` (New File) Add the `Highlight` struct to define the structure of the returned snippets: ```go type Highlight struct { Property string `json:"property"` Fragments []string `json:"fragments"` // highlighted text snippets } ``` ### `entities/additional/classification.go` Update the `Properties` struct to include the toggle: ```go type Properties struct { // ... existing fields Highlight bool `json:"highlight"` } ``` --- ## 2. GraphQL API Updates ### `adapters/handlers/graphql/local/get/class_builder.go` * Add `highlight` field to additional fields. * Implement the `additionalHighlightField()` method. ### `adapters/handlers/graphql/local/get/class_builder_fields.go` * Add `highlight` to the `isAdditional()` check. * Implement extraction logic for the following input parameters: | Parameter | Type | Description | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `highlight` | Boolean | Enables the highlighting feature | `false` | | `highlightFragments` | Integer | Number of fragments to return | `1` | | `highlightFragmentSeparator` | String | String used to join fragments | `...` | | `highlightProperty` | String | Specific property to highlight | Optional | --- ## 3. Backend Implementation ### `adapters/repos/db/inverted/bm25_searcher.go` The core logic resides here. During the scoring phase, the system must: 1. **Track Terms:** Identify which query terms matched specific documents. 2. **Fetch Content:** Retrieve the original text for those documents. 3. **Generate Snippets:** Use term positions to create fragments with `` tags. **Key Functions:** * `extractMatchingTerms()`: Identifies matching query terms per document. * `generateHighlightedFragments()`: Handles the string manipulation for snippet creation. * **Storage:** Results are stored in `result.AdditionalProperties["highlight"]`. --- ## 4. Result Structure Example ```json { "Get": { "Article": [ { "title": "My Article", "content": "The quick brown fox...", "_additional": { "highlight": [ { "property": "content", "fragments": ["The quick brown fox..."] } ] } } ] } } ``` --- ## 5. Files to Modify | File | Changes | | --- | --- | | `entities/additional/classification.go` | Add `Highlight` bool field | | `entities/additional/highlight.go` | **NEW** - Create `Highlight` struct | | `adapters/handlers/graphql/local/get/class_builder.go` | Add highlight GraphQL field | | `adapters/handlers/graphql/local/get/class_builder_fields.go` | Add highlight extraction | | `adapters/repos/db/inverted/bm25_searcher.go` | Implement highlight generation | | `adapters/repos/db/inverted/bm25_searcher_block.go` | Block-based highlighting | | `usecases/traverser/explorer.go` | Populate highlights in results | | `entities/search/result.go` | Add `Highlight` field to `Result` | --- ## 6. Proposed Task List * [ ] Create `entities/additional/highlight.go` with `Highlight` struct * [ ] Add `Highlight` field to `entities/additional/classification.go` * [ ] Add GraphQL field in `class_builder.go` * [ ] Add field extraction in `class_builder_fields.go` * [ ] Implement highlight generation in `BM25 searcher` * [ ] Add highlighting for hybrid search * [ ] Populate highlights in explorer results * [ ] Add unit tests for highlighting logic * [ ] Add integration tests for end-to-end highlighting --- ## 7. Considerations * **Fragment Size:** Implement a limit on fragment length to prevent bloated API payloads. * **Fragment Count:** Ensure users can configure how many snippets they receive per property. * **Multi-property:** Ensure the logic iterates correctly over multiple requested properties. * **Performance:** Use **lazy-loading** for the original document text; only fetch it if the `highlight` flag is explicitly requested.
